**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Total Accountants working = Total joined - Total left

Working = (35 + 26 + 15 + 20 + 14) - (16 + 5 + 38 + 24)

Working = 110 - 83 = 27

**∴ The total number of accountants working in the organization in the year 2019 is 27.**
